scope: All153 target phrases were exposed before this experiment. Fresh opt-in nasal prototype only; no learned history, native application, latency acceptance or independent validation.

model.kind: Dictionary-word type character prior, not measured sentence LM
model.data_distribution_policy: CC-BY-SA-4.0 combined adaptation; retainoriginalRimeCCBY4 andwords.hkPD notices; no programcode license implication.
model.formula: p1(c)=(typeCharacterCount(c)+0.1)/(318418+0.1*(6911+1)); p2(c|p)=(typeBigramCount(p,c)+10*p1(c))/(outgoing(p)+10); cost=min(16,-ln(p2)). Sum over all characters; start/unknown previous0 has outgoing0 and backs off to p1. No EOS.
model.source_boundary: FinalDB winning Rime explicit words and words.hk wordlist only, deduplicated2-32Han written types. Does not include raw Rime text-only phrases or conversational sentence counts; winner provenance is not exhaustive raw-source attestation.

ranking: score' = originalScore - weight*wholeOutputCharacterCost for composed candidates only. Direct words and completions unchanged; only saved first90 candidates are reordered.

source_bindings.grid_preparation_input_caveat: The runner did not separately include eval/yale_expected.json in before/after guards, although prepare_cases reads it. Its current hash matches both fixtures' recorded grid477f56a9; every saved raw input was independently matched to frozen fixture literals by this audit. Future runs should pin it explicitly.

limitations: Top90 presence is invariant by construction; cannot recover missing paths or establish exhaustive engine reachability.
Exact written text is the metric; fixed target readings are retained but pronunciation-match accuracy was not scored.
All fixed coefficients, gains and losses are reported; selecting a coefficient is exposed development tuning.
A positive per-character cost can bias candidates of different output lengths, and unmodified direct/completion priorities can dominate composed alternatives.
No personalized span-anchor calibration or native deadline/GUI test was performed.
Lexicon word-type counts are not conversational usage frequencies; no language-quality or release gate is passed by this pilot.

decision.reason: Evenweight0.25 loses a previously first9 old-case target; larger coefficients introduce more losses. Many target texts are missing from the original90 and cannot be rescued by reranking.
decision.next_single_experiment: Keep saved203 pools, fixed scoring formula and weight0.25 unchanged. Change only prior source selection to include locked raw Rime text-only phrase types, once per unique written text, alongside the same explicit-word types. Compare every gain/loss against this narrow prior. This isolates a licensed-data coverage hypothesis without new engine queries or decoder changes; it remains development and needs a newly frozen untouched validation cohort before any shipping decision.
